purpose: Non-executing static review of a historical public Cydia package, not a jailbreak, DRM decryption, Samsung-root method or Secure Folder bypass.

cydia.provenanceLimit: Historical version explicitly listed by the author-linked HTTPS repository. Index size/MD5 checks are not a modern authenticated repository-signature chain or independent publisher authentication. A measured SHA-256 is recorded before static analysis; no claim this is the latest Cydia or compatible with any current jailbreak.

appleMachOReference.limit: LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO and LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO_64 describe a binary range/cryptid. A zero or absent command is not proof of no application-data encryption, and a nonzero cryptid is not decrypted by this workflow.

sourceMirror.limit: Third-party 2017 mirror claiming git.saurik.com origin; not an authenticated official GitHub account and not verified to reproduce the downloaded binary.
